name: ListTemplates

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region in which you want to query templates
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the template. All templates whose names contain the specified template name are to be returned
parameters.help_zh: 模板名称。列出含所填模板名称的所有模板
parameters.name: template_name

parameters.help_en:
The format of the template. Valid values:

JSON
YAML
parameters.help_zh:
模板格式。取值范围：
JSON
YAML
parameters.name: template_format

parameters.help_en:
The share type of the template. Valid values:

Public
Private
parameters.help_zh:
分享类型。取值范围：
Public
Private
parameters.name: share_type

parameters.help_en:
The creator of the template.

To query the template provided by Alibaba Cloud, set this parameter to ACS.
To query the template created by a user, set this parameter to the ID of the template or the name of the user who creates the template
parameters.help_zh:
模板创建者。
对于阿里云官方提供的模板，为ACS
对于用户个人创建的模板，可填写 UID 进行筛选，或填写 用户名称 进行筛选
parameters.name: created_by

parameters.help_en:
Specifies to query the template that is created at or before the specified time.

The value must be in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm::ssZ format
parameters.help_zh:
创建时间小于等于指定时间的模板。


格式为：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm::ssZ
parameters.name: created_date_before

parameters.help_en:
Specifies to query the template that is created at or later than the specified time.

The value must be in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format
parameters.help_zh:
创建时间大于等于指定时间的模板。

格式为：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: created_date_after

parameters.help_en: The tag keys and values. The number of key-value pairs ranges from 1 to 20
parameters.help_zh: 标签键及值，键值对数量限制为1至20
parameters.name: tags

parameters.help_en: The type of the template. Valid values include TimerTrigger, EventTrigger, AlarmTrigger, and Other
parameters.name: category

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 10 to 100. Default value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小。取值范围：10-100。默认为50
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results
parameters.help_zh: 对查询结果进行翻页时需要传入的Token值，如有则获取自当前页的返回值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The field that is used to sort the templates to be queried. Valid values:

TotalExecutionCount (default): The system sorts the returned templates based on the total number of times that the templates are used.
Popularity: The system sorts the returned templates based on the popularity of the templates.
TemplateName: The system sorts the returned templates based on the names of the templates.
CreatedDate: The system sorts the returned templates based on the points in time when the templates are created.
UpdatedDate: The system sorts the returned templates based on the points in time when the templates are updated
parameters.help_zh:
排序字段。取值范围：

TotalExecutionCount（默认值）：总执行次数
Popularity：受欢迎程度
TemplateName：模板名称
CreatedDate：创建时间
UpdatedDate：更新时间
parameters.name: sort_field

parameters.help_en:
The order in which you want to sort the results. Valid values:

Ascending: ascending order.
Descending: descending order. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
排序方向。取值范围：

Ascending：升序
Descending（默认值）：降序
parameters.name: sort_order

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to query the template that is configured with a trigger
parameters.name: has_trigger

parameters.help_en:
The type of the template. Valid values:

Automation: the template for automated tasks.
State: the template for configuration inventories.
Package: the template for software packages
parameters.help_zh:
模版类型：
Automation：自动化
State：配置清单
Package：软件包
parameters.name: template_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the template is added to favorites
parameters.name: is_favorite

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the template is an example template
parameters.name: is_example
